verdict.line: You lose if you walk into her Hallowed Mist on cooldown and eat a full Skip 'n Slash trade; you win if you poke her down with Corrosive Charge before she can close the gap.

brief.thesis: Corrosive Charge (800 range) and Purge (490 range) both outrange everything Gwen has — Snip Snip! (450) and Skip 'n Slash (400) — so she physically cannot touch you until she closes the gap with E. Her only real defensive tool, W (Hallowed Mist), only works if you walk into it; stand at max range and she has no way to force a trade, which is why Urgot holds a measured 47.6% win rate over 662 games with a clear lane and solo-kill edge despite the games being even overall.

theirWindow.when: W is up and you enter the mist
theirWindow.what: Inside the mist she becomes targetable again and can answer with E (Skip 'n Slash) for bonus attack speed, range, and on-hit magic damage. Don't walk in to auto-trade unless you're ready to commit to a kill — a half-trade inside her mist just lets her heal off A Thousand Cuts.

yourWindow.when: her E (Skip 'n Slash) is on cooldown (13-11s)
yourWindow.what: She has no gap-closer for 11-13 seconds after using it. Step up and land free Corrosive Charges, or walk her down with Purge — she cannot punish you for standing in her face during this window.

start.why: 84.8% pick rate for a reason — the extra damage and sustain let you win extended poke trades at the range where she can't hit back, without needing to commit to all-ins.

boots.why: Tenacity and magic resist directly counter her magic on-hit poke and any team CC that sets up her all-in, and it's the higher-pick, higher-winrate option (46.9% pick, 44.9% win).

core.why: Armor shred scales your physical poke hard in extended trades and gives you the haste to keep Corrosive Charge up.
Survives her burst window if she catches you in Hallowed Mist and buys time to disengage with Disdain.
The highest-pick third item (20.1%) at 44.9% win — gives you the tankiness to keep pressuring sidelanes once laning phase ends.

situational.when: she's building burst magic damage and threatening you with a single all-in
you need more sustained damage output to win skirmishes against her splitpush
her A Thousand Cuts healing is outpacing the damage you're landing in trades

runes.keystoneWhy: The vulnerable mark boosts the damage of your follow-up hits in a trade, which matters because Gwen's passive heals her back — you need the burst window to outpace her sustain before she can reset.

summoners.why: 86.1% pick rate and the highest winrate of the three options (47.6%) — Ignite shuts down the healing from A Thousand Cuts and converts your range advantage into the solo kills the data says you're favored for.

playing.title: Poke from max range
playing.detail: Corrosive Charge (800 range) and Purge (490 range) both outreach her entire kit. Hold that distance and chip her down before she can dash in.

playing.title: Don't chase into Hallowed Mist
playing.detail: She's only targetable inside the mist. Walking in on cooldown just hands her a free Skip 'n Slash trade with bonus attack speed and on-hit damage.

playing.title: Disdain her mid-dash
playing.detail: Time E (Disdain) for the moment she commits with Skip 'n Slash — catching her mid-engage cancels her empowered window and hurls her back out of range.

playing.title: Trade hard when her E is down
playing.detail: After she uses Skip 'n Slash, she has 11-13 seconds with no gap-closer. Step up and punish freely during that window.

playing.title: Threaten the R pick
playing.detail: From level 6, Fear Beyond Death's 2500 range means any overextension is a death sentence for her — use that threat to deny her trades even before you cast it.

playing.title: Itemize against her sustain
playing.detail: If A Thousand Cuts is healing her back to even in trades, pivot toward Thornmail — the grievous wounds matters more than raw damage here.

playing.title: Shred her with Cleaver stacks
playing.detail: Black Cleaver's armor shred compounds across a trade — the longer the fight runs, the harder your autos and Q hit.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all winrate/pickrate numbers are measured from real games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade-window calls are my own read of the kits, not measured data.
